RBI Clarifies FEMA Rules on Personal Transaction Reporting

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has clarified that individuals do not need to report personal transactions under the new Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) rules. This clarification pertains to personal service transactions.
